mostWorthwhile.text: Renewing the bone patch was most worthwhile: clearing and rebuilding it made an otherwise hidden process easy to follow.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining the skin and blood results felt mostly like assembling things already shown, rather than adding much explanation.

surprise.text: I was surprised that bone is continually renewed in small patches while the rest stays in place.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless, though most choices were the only available combination, so the chapter offered little decision-making.

continue.text: I'd be mildly interested in another chapter if it explored a new body process, but the mostly automatic sequence didn't leave me strongly hooked.
